verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a developer API (cards, payments, transactions, Boleto) on a Redocly portal, so this axis applies. However, no evidence item states that a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is offered, and probes of the common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. Hosting on Redocly suggests an underlying spec may exist, but that is inference, not documented support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
